findings.current: 无法读取你的点赞和收藏，因此此处不显示你对此智能体的状态。
findings.problem: “你对此智能体的状态” is a literal rendering of the English jargon “this agent's viewer state”. In Chinese, 对此 collocates with 态度/看法/反应, not 状态, and the phrase leaves 状态 unspecified one clause after the sentence has already named the only two states there are. Meaning is recoverable, so this is a clarity/idiom defect rather than an accuracy error — but it is the one sentence in the file that reads translated rather than written.
findings.proposed: 无法读取你的点赞和收藏，因此此处不显示你与该智能体的互动状态。 (terser alternative: 因此此处不显示相关状态。)

terminology.detail: Glossary: agent → 智能体 (365 occurrences across the zh-CN catalogues, this candidate included), consistent through card, details and aria; no drift to 代理 or 智能代理. Favourite family 收藏 / 取消收藏 matches the shipped ui.library terms (status.favorites, menu.favorite, menu.unfavorite). Like family 点赞 / 取消点赞 has no earlier shipped zh-CN use, so this namespace sets it; 点赞 is the standard social verb and pairs consistently with the favourite family across aria, tooltip and failure strings. Delist family 下架 (aria, confirm, title, tooltip, body, status, failure) is the standard marketplace term and uses one verb throughout. 智能体中心 is the shipped rendering of Agent Hub in four other catalogues (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub, ui.command_palette.use_palette_sources.agent_hub, ui.hub.updates.error.model_unavailable, ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link); 中心 as its short form in delist_body matches shipped 上传到中心. Radient stays Latin in all four occurrences. 更新于 has a shipped precedent (ui.settings.imports.session_updated = 更新于{date}).

age_date_joins.detail: hubAge delegates to the ui.hub.comments.age.* ICU messages, whose zh-CN values end in 前 ({count}天前), and formatCalendarDate is Intl year/month/day long, which renders 2026年10月25日 in zh-CN. So card.updated reads 更新于3天前 (no second preposition, leading word kept before the placeholder) and details.created reads 创建：3天前（2026年10月25日） with the fullwidth parentheses wrapping a complete date, not a fragment.

observations.note: Agent Hub is rendered 智能体中心 (and 中心 in delist_body), not kept in English. The English sidecar calls Agent Hub a surface name, but i18n/glossary.md's keep-English table does not list it, every shipped locale localises that surface, and four shipped zh-CN catalogues already use 智能体中心 for it. Consistency with the shipped product wins; no finding.

Caller-side, not this catalogue: backendLoadErrorMessage (src/renderer/src/shared/api/local-operator/backend-error.ts:182-186) joins lead, diagnosis and remedy with ASCII ' '. For zh-CN this renders a U+0020 between fullwidth sentences ('…没有响应。 后端…'), against the locale's no-ASCII-space convention. The diagnosis and remedy are themselves translated via t(). Changing the join is a code change and is not counted against the translation.

Caller-side: agent-details-page.tsx:124-129 assembles the author as `${name} (${email})` with an ASCII space and ASCII parentheses, so a zh-CN detail page can render 创建者：张三 (a@b.com) inside an otherwise fullwidth line. No catalogue value can fix it; not counted as a finding.

Source-level: the tooltip says 永久下架 while the dialog body says the agent can be re-uploaded later. The same tension exists in English ('Permanently delist' vs 'upload it again later') and the sidecar explains 'permanently' as removal from the public listing, not account deletion. The translation mirrors the source faithfully rather than resolving it; not a translation defect.

Mechanical work ran through the repo's own gates plus a programmatic pass (JSON/member/order checks, intl-messageformat AST argument comparison, NFC, punctuation and bidi scans, codepoint widths) and a term-frequency comparison against all 5,453 shipped zh-CN values.
